answer: Votes on a voyage affecting lotus wetlands and juniper habitat use locked stake, not account counts. Each key must escrow at least 100 native tokens for 90 days; its voting weight equals its locked balance. A public contract binds escrow to the key, counts it once per proposal and blocks early withdrawal. Splitting stake adds no weight, and n simultaneous aliases need at least 100n locked tokens: linear cost. Anyone can verify balances, votes and unlock times on-chain.
